admin.title: Company articles
admin.subtitle: Internal how-we-do-it guides: who approves, where the templates are, what the schedule is. Published articles are visible to all employees in Help.
admin.emptyText: Write the first guide: for example, who approves a contract or where the letter templates are. While an article is a draft, only you can see it.
admin.emptyReadOnly: The administrator has not written any articles yet. Published articles will appear in Help.
admin.noMatchText: Reset the filter to see all articles.
admin.loadErrorText: Check your connection and try again. If that does not help, write to the administrator.
admin.readOnly: You can read articles, drafts included. Only the administrator can write and publish them.
admin.counts: Articles in total: {{total}}, of them drafts: {{drafts}}

done.published: Article published: all employees can now see it.
done.unpublished: Article unpublished and is a draft again.

delete.title: Delete the article?
delete.text: The article “{{title}}” will be deleted for good and cannot be restored. If it is published, it disappears from Help for everyone.

unpublishConfirm.title: Unpublish the article?
unpublishConfirm.text: The article “{{title}}” will disappear from Help for all employees and become a draft.

admin.panelText: A published article appears in Help under “How we do it” and is found by the common search together with the Platform articles.

editor.titlePlaceholder: For example: Who approves a contract
editor.titleTooLong: The title is longer than {{max}} characters: shorten it.
editor.bodyTooLong: The text is longer than {{max}} characters: shorten it.
editor.bodyHelp: You can use: ## heading, paragraphs, lists (- item or 1. item), **bold**, `code`. Links and HTML do not work: anything you write in angle brackets stays plain text.
editor.previewTitle: This is how the article looks in Help
editor.previewEmpty: The article text will appear here once you start writing.
editor.consequenceDraft: “Save draft” — only you and the director will see the article.
editor.consequencePublish: “Save and publish” — the article appears in Help for all employees at once, under “How we do it”.
editor.consequencePublished: The article is already published: your edit is visible to everyone at once.

errors.article_title_too_long: The title is longer than 200 characters: shorten it.
errors.article_body_too_long: The text is longer than 20000 characters: shorten it.
errors.article_language_unknown: Choose a language from the list.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The article is gone: another administrator may have deleted it. Go back to the list.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only the administrator can edit company articles.
